factions.name: Western Concord
factions.description: A coalition of free nations. Concord forces favour mobility, precision and air power: fast Lancer tanks, long-range Longbow artillery, Ranger snipers and Hawk gunships, protected by Sentinel turrets and Skyguard flak.

factions.name: Iron Pact
factions.description: A vast eastern union of industry and iron discipline. Pact armour is slow but brutal: Bear heavy tanks, Thunder rocket launchers and the colossal Titan, guarded by Flame Bunkers and devastating Arc Towers.

factions.name: Civilians
factions.description: Townsfolk, oil workers and anyone else caught between the armies.
